about: Which frame of which Matte piece (docs/adr/0015, app/matte.py) shows a time into a cut-out Segment. A Segment is its range on the Source, `start` to `end`, and how it plays it: `speed` (1 by default), `reverse` (false) and `hold` (none), as in segment_times.json; `offset` is seconds into it on the Timeline, and `source` the Source time it shows there (docs/adr/0009). The Source's frame there is `round(source × fps)`; it is in the 10 s piece from `piece` seconds, whose frame `frame` it is (the piece's frames start at its own first frame of the Source, `round(piece × fps)`). Read by backend/tests/test_matte_frames.py and frontend/src/pages/job/editor/matteTime.test.ts, so that the backend's and the preview's mappings can't drift.
